The energetics of rotating machinery (blowers and compressors) are evaluated in terms of isentropic efficiency, which determines both power requirements and adiabatic heating inside the process. The high-fidelity mass balances for the MSU units defined the retentate gas composition, which was evaluated as a generator fuel stream operating at 30% thermal efficiency. These inputs allowed us to demonstrate 40% of the power generated is required to operate the process, with 60% available for net metering to the grid as shown in Table 1. Table 1.
